subject: maths
question: Triangle PQR is similar to Triangle XYZ. The ratio of their perimeters is 3:4. What is the ratio of the length of the median from vertex P to the length of the median from vertex X?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In **similar triangles**, the ratio of any **corresponding linear segments** (such as sides, perimeters, medians, altitudes, or angle bisectors) is always **equal**.

Ratio of perimeters = 3 : 4

Ratio of corresponding medians = Ratio of perimeters

∴ Ratio of medians = 3 : 4

**∴ The correct answer is 3:4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** ΔPQR ∼ ΔXYZ and Perimeter(ΔPQR) : Perimeter(ΔXYZ) = 3 : 4.

**Formula Used:** For two similar triangles, Ratio of Perimeters = Ratio of Sides = Ratio of Medians = Ratio of Altitudes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9519e7748189115e7132261d56292102d7dc29af939d35c8d6e3c0f5dcf0a6c6.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the sides of ΔPQR be a₁, b₁, c₁ and sides of ΔXYZ be a₂, b₂, c₂.

⇒ Perimeter of ΔPQR / Perimeter of ΔXYZ = 3 / 4

⇒ By the property of **similarity**, the ratio of corresponding sides is equal to the ratio of perimeters.

⇒ Ratio of sides = 3 / 4

⇒ Corresponding **medians** of similar triangles are in the **same ratio** as their corresponding sides.

⇒ Length of median from P / Length of median from X = Ratio of sides = 3 / 4

**∴ The correct answer is 3:4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area Ratio Property

The ratio of the areas of two similar triangles is equal to the square of the ratio of their corresponding linear dimensions (sides, medians, or perimeters). Area Ratio = (3/4)² = 9/16.

Median Definition

A median of a triangle is a line segment joining a vertex to the midpoint of the opposite side. Every triangle has exactly three medians, which intersect at the centroid.

Similarity Criteria

Triangles are similar if their corresponding angles are equal (AA) or if their corresponding sides are in the same proportion (SSS or SAS).</p
